svg.title: Open source pull requests
svg.desc: Merged upstream. xAI: Made xAI's Python SDK compatible with protobuf 7. Pull requests: xai-sdk-python #223. Google DeepMind: Fixed an out-of-bounds memory write in OpenSpiel's Dou Dizhu game. Pull requests: concordia #276 #299 #300, open_spiel #1602. boltons: Fixed 9 bugs in boltons, from list slicing to seeking in JSONL streams. Pull requests: 9 pull requests. AboutCode: Fixed license scans missing Chinese and Japanese license texts. Pull requests: scancode-toolkit #4781 #5343. In review. NVIDIA: Stopped garak's AI safety judge from losing the question it was grading. Pull requests: garak #2383, NVTX #181. Microsoft: Fixed NVIDIA model settings crashing every request in Semantic Kernel. Pull requests: knack #309, semantic-kernel #14698. OpenAI: Fixed finished fine-tuning jobs still showing Running in the .NET SDK. Pull requests: whisper #2846 #2847, openai-dotnet #1456, tiktoken #611. Google: Stopped Gemini CLI losing tool results when it recovers from a loop. Pull requests: etils #831, gemini-cli #29871, python-fire #704. Anthropic: Let developers clear a tool's description in Anthropic's Python SDK. Pull requests: anthropic-sdk-python #1913. Hugging Face: Let evaluate save results on machines without Git installed. Pull requests: evaluate #808 #809.

g.text: Made xAI's Python SDK compatible with protobuf 7.
Fixed an out-of-bounds memory write in OpenSpiel's Dou Dizhu game.
Fixed 9 bugs in boltons, from list slicing to seeking in JSONL streams.
Fixed license scans missing Chinese and Japanese license texts.
Stopped garak's AI safety judge from losing the question it was grading.
Fixed NVIDIA model settings crashing every request in Semantic Kernel.
Fixed finished fine-tuning jobs still showing Running in the .NET SDK.
Stopped Gemini CLI losing tool results when it recovers from a loop.
Let developers clear a tool's description in Anthropic's Python SDK.
Let evaluate save results on machines without Git installed.

svg.text: 18 merged 48 in review 74 upstream pull requests
